traits.description:
Timmy doesn't react to insults or to either part failing a flirt attempt.
(Big and Small - Genes & More)

traits.description:
Timmy isn't bothered by rough appearances, a bit of rough living. Timmy also doesn't care as much for royal titles.
(Big and Small - Genes & More)
traits.name: unpretentious

traits.description:
Timmy is truly gigantic by the standards of their kind. They are sturdier than usual, but being significantly larger than normal for their kind does slow them down somewhat and make them more prone to early heart attacks and other health-issues.
(Big and Small - Genes & More)
traits.name: gigantism

Timmy is both taller and bulkier than usual for their kind. This makes them sturdier but slightly slower.
(Big and Small - Genes & More)

Psychic enthrallment caused by incredibly strong mental influence. Thralls don't need to sleep or have recreation, but are unable to do skilled work and engage in social interactions.
(Vanilla Psycasts Expanded)

traits.description:
Timmy is good at getting his way. Be it love bombing or gaslighting, his victims rarely notice what’s truly going on.
(The Sims Traits)
traits.name: manipulative

traits.description:
Timmy was taught everyone is good and kind. Maybe one day he will learn the lesson the hard way.
(The Sims Traits)
traits.name: naive

traits.description:
Timmy believes in pretty privilege. he is desperate to achieve flawless beauty by any means.
(The Sims Traits)
traits.name: narcissist

traits.description:
Timmy’s body is a temple, he only eats food to survive. he is here for a long time, not a good time.
(The Sims Traits)
traits.name: healthnut

traits.description:
Timmy feels his emotions more profoundly and experiences greater mood swings. he often cries to release any frustration.
(The Sims Traits)
traits.name: emotional

traits.description:
Timmy believes good luck is an illusion and bad things are bound to happen. he is always ready for the worst case scenario.
(The Sims Traits)
traits.name: paranoid

traits.description:
Timmy acts funny in the day-to-day life. he silly nature often amuses others.
(The Sims Traits)
traits.name: goofball

traits.description:
Timmy is never gonna give you up.
(The Sims Traits)
stats: Giving up and leaving mental state disabled.
Giving up and leaving mental state disabled.

traits.name: loyal

traits.description:
For Timmy, every season is party season!
(The Sims Traits)
traits.name: partyanimal

traits.description:
Timmy always seem out of place. No one knows what’s going on in his head, not even himself.
(The Sims Traits)
traits.name: insane

traits.description:
Follow the dress code, say the right word. Timmy has immaculate manners that navigate him through every social occasion.
(The Sims Traits)
traits.name: proper

traits.description:
Timmy always seems annoyed, especially on a Monday. Others around him are constantly afraid to trigger his grumbles.
(The Sims Traits)
traits.name: grumpy

traits.description:
Timmy struggles to socialise with other people, he especially cherish it while being on the receiving end of kindness.

Over the time, Timmy have learned to spend more time on organising and introspecting himself.
(The Sims Traits)
traits.name: shy

traits.description:
Timmy likes buying and bragging about his new possessions.
(The Sims Traits)
traits.name: materialistic

traits.description:
Timmy avoids eating meat. he believes animals should not be treated as commodities and knows how to use plants to make delicious meals.
(The Sims Traits)
traits.name: vegan

traits.description:
Timmy devotes his body and soul to what he believes. Somehow, his prayers get answered.
(The Sims Traits)
traits.name: devout

traits.description:
Timmy likes to put things off until the last minute. he still manages to get those tasks done but the results are usually lacklustre.
(The Sims Traits)
traits.name: procrastinator

traits.description:
Timmy becomes tense after a while in the same job or relationship. his fear of commitment facilitates change.
(The Sims Traits)
traits.name: non-committal

traits.description:
Timmy can feel a pea under twenty mattresses while sleeping. he is born blue blood with expensive taste and trivial problems.
(The Sims Traits)
traits.name: highmaintenance

traits.description:
Timmy want big families and enjoy being surrounded by children. he will make an excellent parent!
(The Sims Traits)
traits.name: familyoriented

traits.description:
Timmy has a pair of steady hands that never shakes or even trembles under pressure.
(The Sims Traits)
traits.name: steadyhands

traits.description:
Timmy enjoys chaos and takes the extreme side in life. he can’t quit the adrenaline rush from being reckless.
(The Sims Traits)
traits.name: daredevil

traits.description:
Timmy likes to talk and he sure talks a lot. People around him have started to develop immunity to whatever he says.
(The Sims Traits)
traits.name: chatterbox

traits.description:
Timmy has a deep love for reading. he reads fast and enjoys expanding his knowledge this way.
(The Sims Traits)
traits.name: bookworm

traits.description:
Timmy likes to get on with his hands and tinkers around. he has the natural aptitude of handling those tiny precision components.
(The Sims Traits)
traits.name: handy

traits.description:
Timmy has a natural gift with musical and instruments. It is as if the music he plays lingered in the air.
(The Sims Traits)
traits.name: virtuoso

traits.description:
Timmy is brilliant with computers and technology. he can hack into other people’s data and security systems with ease.
(The Sims Traits)
traits.name: techwhiz

traits.description:
Timmy believes in his own luck. Despite the crippling addiction, his luck certainly tips in a different direction on the battlefield.
(The Sims Traits)
traits.name: gambler

traits.description:
Timmy never lost that childlike wonder. he sees things through the eyes of a child and need to be constantly entertained.
(The Sims Traits)
traits.name: childish

traits.description:
Timmy ignores others' boundaries and likes pressing for more information, this often rubs people the wrong way.
(The Sims Traits)
traits.name: nosy

traits.description:
Timmy is noted for his incredible strength, increasing melee armor penetration and neolithic weapon range.
(The Sims Traits)
traits.name: hugepower

traits.description:
Timmy has a pair of keen eyes that scans through every detail and miss no strange things.
(The Sims Traits)
traits.name: observant

traits.description:
Timmy takes time to discover beauty in everything. he sees the world in a grain of sand.

To him, actively sabotaging life is a despicable act.
(The Sims Traits)
traits.name: zen

traits.description:
Timmy wants to be told what to do. Following rules and obeying authority are their second nature.
(The Sims Traits)
traits.name: submissive

traits.description:
Timmy is supposedly a hand-to-hand combat specialist, but only when inebriated. he claim to become more talented the more drunk he are.
(The Sims Traits)
traits.name: drunkenmaster

traits.description:
Timmy is never really asleep or awake. he is almost zombie like, lurching along and working very slowly.
(The Sims Traits)
traits.name: insomniac
